repos_data.description: Find buried material events in SEC 8-K filings the filer did not report. Pure Python regex classifier, no LLM. Powered by FilingFirehose.

Constat — FDA & NHTSA regulatory-risk MCP server for AI agents. 14 tools: recalls, adverse events, warning letters, 483s, 510(k) predicate chains, reimbursement, vehicle safety. com.healthai/radar on the official MCP registry. Hosted at constat.dev/api/mcp.
